title: Dana wrong password
symptom: After updating to version 2.8.2.1 and importing settings from 2.6.2, the user gets an error that the pump password is incorrect and cannot make a bolus. The pump is connected and password is correct, and reverting to 2.6.2 works.
cause: In version 2.6.2, the password was not verified for RS v1 pump, but in 2.8.2 it is. The user has an old Dana Diabecare pump (Dana R from 2013) with old firmware that cannot change the default password using code 3463, so the password verification fails.
fix: The thread suggests that the user may need to upgrade the pump firmware to v2 to be able to change the pump password using code 3463, or find the password from log files. The user contacted the producer and confirmed password change is not possible on their pump.
